preconditions.description: The number of pillars n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The minimum height difference d must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= h <= 10**15 for h in heights)
preconditions.description: Each pillar height must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximal length k followed by the indices of the pillars in the jump sequence.
The number of indices in the output must match the maximal length k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= indices[i] <= n for i in range(len(indices)))
postconditions.description: All indices in the output must be valid pillar indices between 1 and n.
